reason: A configurable reverse-proxy gateway that exposes the DeepSeek Harness web GUI to LAN or external clients, with optional password authentication, TLS, and a browser UUID compatibility shim.

summaries.zh: 这是一个将 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 通过可配置反向代理开放到局域网或公网的网关插件，并提供密码鉴权、TLS 和浏览器 UUID 兼容支持。
summaries.en: A configurable reverse-proxy gateway plugin that exposes the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI to LAN or external clients with password authentication, TLS options, and a browser UUID compatibility shim.

capabilities: listens on a configurable network address and port
reverse-proxies HTTP and WebSocket traffic to a local web interface
provides password-based login and HMAC session cookies
generates or loads TLS certificates and private keys
modifies client-side behavior with a UUID compatibility shim
